info.title: Family native API additions
info.description: Contract for stabilization, atomic person/relationship creation and Me selection. Existing tree/profile/upload/session routes remain outside this contract. Request schemas are generated from the runtime Zod validators. Local permanent-delete behavior precedes the planned soft-delete migration.
